bible_verses.english: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
“Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has, and buys that field.

Yes, most certainly, I count all things to be loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for being my strength when I am weary and my treasure above all else. Forgive me for the times I look for satisfaction in things that fade, and draw my heart back to Your precious grace. You bore my sin and shame on the cross so that I could live in freedom. Today, I surrender my whole life to You, knowing You truly are my all in all. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When we feel exhausted or inadequate, this beloved song reminds us that Jesus meets us right in our weakness with His limitless grace. He is not just a help along the way—He is our ultimate treasure, worth letting go of everything else to pursue. As we lift our voices together, we remember that He bore our sin and shame so we could walk in His strength. May our hearts rest in the joyful truth that in Him, we lack nothing.
